metadata.title: Creator sign in - LineME
metadata.description: Sign in to securely publish and manage your LineME queues.

auth.title: Sign in to publish your line
auth.description: Your draft is saved on this device. Sign in so only you can publish, edit, pause, and manage the line.
auth.sent: Check your email. Your secure sign-in link is on its way.
auth.notice: Visitors do not need an account to join a line. Sign-in is only required for line creators and managers.
